items.claim: Brand 从进攻演示转向防御评估，发布 MTE Part 1，核心研究问题为 'whether it's possible to use this instruction set extension to implement effective security mitigations, or whether its use is limited to debugging/fault detection purposes'。建立分类法：Soft mitigation='attacker pays a one-time cost'；Hard mitigation='cannot develop a bypass technique which is reusable between different vulnerabilities'；Solution='eliminates exploitability of a vulnerability or class'。设定 95% 可靠性阈值（CONFIG_HZ_250 下需 ~0.2ms 完成）。
items.growth_signal: 机制：方法转型——从 '找 bug/写 exploit' 转向 '以攻击者视角评估防御是否成立'。建立可量化的评估框架（soft/hard/solution + 明确可靠性阈值），使 '缓解措施是否有效' 从主观判断转为可复现度量。这是其智识谱系从纯进攻到攻防一体的关键转折。

items.claim: Several months in the life of Project Zero - Part 2: The Chrome exploit of suffering（projectzero.google/2020/02/several-months-in-life-of-part2.html）一手正文，byline 为 'Sergei Glazunov and Mark Brand'，发布日期 2020-Feb-11。正文对网络栈 exploit 可靠性的定量表述仅明确：终值 'the above total probability should be bumped up to 0.75 per run.'，首个倍率 'This gives us 7/8 instead of 2/8 as the first multiplier of our reliability formula.'，并自述 'it seems to usually take only 2-3 tries before succeeding'、'Given that one run takes about a minute, this is definitely not a satisfactory result, even with the virtually unlimited number of retries that we have.'。一手正文不含 0.375、不含 3%、不含 75%。故 0.375 起点与 3%/75% 均无可考一手出处，应以 0.75 per run 终值与 2/8→7/8 首个倍率、约 2-3 次重试、约每分钟一次且自述不令人满意作为该阶段可靠性定量分析的一手可证内容。

items.claim: Project Zero 博客文章 'Exploiting Android Messengers with WebRTC: Part 1'（URL projectzero.google/2020/08/exploiting-android-messengers-part-1.html）本轮 WebFetch 实际加载成功，byline 为 'Posted by Natalie Silvanovich, Project Zero'，发布日期 2020-Aug-03。一手正文实际写为 'Mark Brand suggested that it might be possible to use CVE-2020-6387 to accomplish this by setting the low bytes of a pointer to outgoing data to zero'，即引文完整包含 'to outgoing data'。故 mb-ext-silvanovich-suggestion-2020 的 claim '注'（称一手正文实为 'setting the low bytes of a pointer to zero'、种子引文有误）与 short_quote 均与一手原文不符：实际是 r1/r2/r3 的'修正'错误删除了原文实际存在的 'to outgoing data'，种子引文才准确。该纠正仅涉及引文准确性，不改变'Brand 在攻坚阶段被 Silvanovich 点名征询利用思路'的核心结论。
